shortBulletSummary: Bitcoin surged past $65,000, extending its uptrend and heading towards $67,000.
Russia enacted a new crypto regulation bill, limiting retail purchases to $3,800 annually but allowing cross-border settlements.
The Crypto Fear & Greed Index moved from 25 to 33, indicating a slight improvement from "Extreme Fear" to "Fear."
Telegram announced plans to launch a native non-custodial Gram wallet for all users, causing the token to surge 7%.
The continuing US-Iran conflict fuels energy and broader geopolitical risks, impacting global markets.
